DarGlobal

Dar Global PLC is a real estate development company listed on the London Stock Exchange.[1]

History

Dar Global was established in 2017 as a subsidiary of its parent company. Its first project of note was a tower next to the Dubai Water Canal, developed with an Italian fashion house.[2][better source needed]

  • 2023: listed on the Main Market.
